instruction: Convert the image "/home/user/logo.png" to vector format and save it as ".pdf" using GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Converting raster PNG to true vector format is infeasible in GIMP. While GIMP can export to PDF, it remains a raster image embedded in PDF, not a vector conversion.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - GIMP cannot perform true raster-to-vector conversion
The infeasible() evaluator is appropriate for tasks that cannot be technically completed as described
Metadata explanation correctly identifies the technical limitation: GIMP can export to PDF but only embeds raster images, not true vector conversion
